method: Manual reading of all generated conversations plus independent scene/fact/question reviews; no empirical human-message frequency calibration.
review: Pizza lunch and evening pizza are several hours apart.
Availability changes are spread across days; most plans are not repeatedly rewritten.
No forced identical workday introductions; casual emails have proper header metadata.
Source and thread IDs are opaque; authoring outcomes never enter provider source metadata.
Uneven deterministic timing is synthetic pacing, not a measured human timing distribution.
Questions ask for requested facts only; historical arrangements do not prove attendance.
Daily chronological backfill preserves source timestamps. This does not measure month-long wall-clock decay.

excluded.holographic: Unsupported: fact storage and regex extraction do not provide document ingestion.
excluded.memori: Excluded: Hermes documents Memori Cloud only; no local document-ingestion integration verified.
excluded.retaindb: Excluded: Hermes documents hosted storage only; the benchmark requires local memory backends.
